a_assign: Copy a vector into a audio signal.
assign_a: Copy a audio signal into a pre-allocated vector or matrix.
assign_f: Copy a spectral signal into a pre-allocated vector or matrix.
assign_mc: Copy a complex matrix into a pre-allocated vector or matrix.
assign_mr: Copy a real matrix into a pre-allocated vector or matrix.
assign_t: Copy a function table into a pre-allocated vector or matrix.
assign_vc: Copy a complex vector into a pre-allocated vector or matrix.
assign_vr: Copy a real vector into a pre-allocated vector or matrix.
conjugate_mc: Take the complex conjugate of a complex matrix.
conjugate_mr: Take the complex conjugate of a real matrix.
conjugate_vc: Take the complex conjugate of a complex vector.
conjugate_vr: Take the complex conjugate of a real vector.
current_f: Test whether the spectral frame is current.
current_vr: Test whether the real vector is at the start of its audio block.
distance_vc: Find the distance between two complex vectors.
distance_vr: Find the distance between two real vectors.
dot_mc: Multiply matrices or a matrix and a vector.
dot_mc_vc: Multiply matrices or a matrix and a vector.
dot_mr: Multiply matrices or a matrix and a vector.
dot_mr_vr: Multiply matrices or a matrix and a vector.
dot_vc: Compute the dot product of two complex vectors.
dot_vr: Compute the dot product of two real vectors.
f_assign: Copy a vector into a spectral signal.
get_mc: Read an element from a complex matrix.
get_mr: Read an element from a real matrix.
get_vc: Read an element from a complex vector.
get_vr: Read an element from a real vector.
invert_mc: Invert a complex matrix and return the determinant.
invert_mr: Invert a real matrix and return the determinant.
lower_solve_mc: Solve a lower triangular system with a complex matrix.
lower_solve_mr: Solve a lower triangular system with a real matrix.
lu_det_mc: Find the determinant of a complex matrix.
lu_det_mr: Find the determinant of a real matrix.
lu_factor_mc: Compute the LU factorization of a complex matrix.
lu_factor_mr: Compute the LU factorization of a real matrix.
lu_solve_mc: Solve a linear system with a complex matrix using LU factorization.
lu_solve_mr: Solve a linear system with a real matrix using LU factorization.
mc_set: Set an element in a complex matrix.
mr_set: Set an element in a real matrix.
norm1_mc: Find the 1-norm of a complex matrix.
norm1_mr: Find the 1-norm of a real matrix.
norm1_vc: Find the 1-norm of a complex vector.
norm1_vr: Find the 1-norm of a real vector.
norm_euclid_mc: Find the Euclidean norm of a complex matrix.
norm_euclid_mr: Find the Euclidean norm of a real matrix.
norm_euclid_vc: Find the Euclidean norm of a complex vector.
norm_euclid_vr: Find the Euclidean norm of a real vector.
norm_inf_mc: Find the infinity norm of a complex matrix.
norm_inf_mr: Find the infinity norm of a real matrix.
norm_inf_vc: Find the infinity norm of a complex vector.
norm_inf_vr: Find the infinity norm of a real vector.
norm_max_mc: Find the maximum norm of a complex matrix.
norm_max_mr: Find the maximum norm of a real matrix.
qr_eigen_mc: Find eigenvalues of a complex matrix using QR iteration.
qr_eigen_mr: Find eigenvalues of a real matrix using QR iteration.
qr_factor_mc: Compute the QR factorization of a complex matrix.
qr_factor_mr: Compute the QR factorization of a real matrix.
qr_sym_eigen_mc: Find eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a symmetric or Hermitian complex matrix.
qr_sym_eigen_mr: Find eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a symmetric or Hermitian real matrix.
random_mc: Fill a complex matrix with random values.
random_mr: Fill a real matrix with random values.
random_vc: Fill a complex vector with random values.
random_vr: Fill a real vector with random values.
size_mc: Return the dimensions of a complex matrix.
size_mr: Return the dimensions of a real matrix.
size_vc: Return the dimensions of a complex vector.
size_vr: Return the dimensions of a real vector.
t_assign: Copy a vector into a function table.
trace_mc: Return the trace of a complex matrix.
trace_mr: Return the trace of a real matrix.
upper_solve_mc: Solve an upper triangular system with a complex matrix.
upper_solve_mr: Solve an upper triangular system with a real matrix.
vc_set: Set an element in a complex vector.
vr_set: Set an element in a real vector.
